ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in Figure 1, in the Cartesian coordinate system, point $A(0,6)$, and point $B$ is a moving point on the positive x-axis. Connect $AB$, take the midpoint $M$ of $AB$, and rotate the segment $MB$ $90^\circ$ clockwise around point $B$ to obtain the segment $BC$. Draw a perpendicular line from point $B$ to the x-axis, intersecting line $AC$ at point $D$. Let the coordinates of point $B$ be $(2t,0)$. Find the coordinates of point $C$ (expressed in terms of $t$).
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in Figure 1, let $ME\perp OB$ at $E$, and $CF\perp$ the x-axis at $F$.\\
Since $B(2t,0)$,\\
it follows that $OB=2t$,\\
Since $ME\parallel OA$ and $AM=BM$,\\
it follows that $OE=EB=t$ and $ME=\frac{1}{2}OA=3$,\\
Since $\angle MEB=\angle CFB=\angle CBM=90^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle MBE+\angle CBF=90^\circ$ and $\angle MBE+\angle BME=90^\circ$,\\
Therefore, $\angle BME=\angle CBF$,\\
Since $BM=BC$,\\
it follows that $\triangle MEB\cong \triangle BFC$ (AAS),\\
Therefore, $BF=ME=3$ and $CF=BE=t$,\\
Therefore, $OF=OB+BF=2t+3$,\\
Therefore, \boxed{C(2t+3,t)}.

推理：设 B=(2t,0)。因为 A=(0,6)，M 是 AB 的中点，所以 M=((0+2t)/2,(6+0)/2)=(t,3)。从 B 指向 M 的向量为 BM=M-B=(t-2t,3-0)=(-t,3)。由图中 C 在 B 的右上方，设 C=(2t+u,v)，其中 u>0, v>0，则 BC=(u,v)。因为 BC 是 MB 绕点 B 顺时针旋转 90° 得到的，所以 BM 与 BC 垂直且长度相等。垂直条件给出 (-t,3)·(u,v)=0，即 -tu+3v=0，所以 v=tu/3。等长条件给出 u^2+v^2=t^2+9。代入 v=tu/3，得 u^2+(t^2u^2)/9=t^2+9，即 u^2(1+t^2/9)=t^2+9，所以 u^2=9。由于图像和顺时针方向显示 C 在 B 的右侧，取 u=3，于是 v=t。因此 C=(2t+3,t)。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in Figure 1, in the Cartesian coordinate system, point $A(0,6)$, and point $B$ is a moving point on the positive x-axis. Connect $AB$, take the midpoint $M$ of $AB$, and rotate the segment $MB$ $90^\circ$ clockwise around point $B$ to obtain the segment $BC$. Draw a perpendicular line from point $B$ to the x-axis, intersecting line $AC$ at point $D$. Let the coordinates of point $B$ be $(2t,0)$. Find the coordinates of point $C$ (expressed in terms of $t$).
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in Figure 1, let $ME\perp OB$ at $E$, and $CF\perp$ the x-axis at $F$.\\
Since $B(2t,0)$,\\
it follows that $OB=2t$,\\
Since $ME\parallel OA$ and $AM=BM$,\\
it follows that $OE=EB=t$ and $ME=\frac{1}{2}OA=3$,\\
Since $\angle MEB=\angle CFB=\angle CBM=90^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle MBE+\angle CBF=90^\circ$ and $\angle MBE+\angle BME=90^\circ$,\\
Therefore, $\angle BME=\angle CBF$,\\
Since $BM=BC$,\\
it follows that $\triangle MEB\cong \triangle BFC$ (AAS),\\
Therefore, $BF=ME=3$ and $CF=BE=t$,\\
Therefore, $OF=OB+BF=2t+3$,\\
Therefore, \boxed{C(2t+3,t)}
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is a plane rectangular coordinate system, point A is on the positive y-axis, and point B is on the positive x-axis; on line segment AB there is midpoint M; starting from B toward the upper right there is line segment BC, indicating that BC is obtained after rotating MB around B clockwise by 90°; through B a vertical line is drawn, intersecting AC at D, but finding the coordinates of C does not need to use D. Then reason: From the problem statement A=(0,6), B=(2t,0). M is the midpoint of AB, so M=((0+2t)/2,(6+0)/2)=(t,3). Taking B as the starting point and looking toward M, the vector is BM_vector=M-B=(t-2t,3-0)=(-t,3). When rotating clockwise by 90°, the vector (x,y) becomes (y,-x), therefore (-t,3) becomes (3,t). So BC_vector=(3,t), hence C=B+BC_vector=(2t,0)+(3,t)=(2t+3,t).
